description: With no favourite, a product carrying a Nectar price outranks a cheaper product with no loyalty price.

input.userMessage: Shop 'coffee' where a basic coffee is cheaper but a Nectar-priced coffee exists.

expectedBehavior.outputFormat: JSON BasketResult whose line is the Nectar-priced product.
expectedBehavior.decisionCriteria: A Nectar/loyalty price outranks a cheaper non-loyalty candidate when neither is a favourite.

scoring.passCriteria: Basket line is the Nectar-priced Nescafe Gold, not the cheaper basic coffee.
